title: Curd Rice
name: Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam)
subtitle: Soft rice mashed into cool curd, with grated cucumber and a crackling mustard-dal tempering.
protein: ~10–12g protein per adult serving — from curd, rice and dals

items.name: Rice (or ¼ cup rice + ¼ millet)

method.title: Cook the rice and mix in the curd
items: Rinse {@rice} well a few times in a bowl
Pour in {@water} and {@salt:cook}; pressure cook 3 whistles until soft (Instant Pot: high 10 min, natural release)
When the pressure releases, mash the rice lightly (or just fluff it if you don't like it mushy); cool completely
Add {@curd} to the cooled rice and mix well until combined
Stir in {@coriander} and {@cucumber}; taste and add {@salt:adjust}

method.label: Toddler — scoop hers here (before the chili tempering)
items: Spoon {=½ cup} of curd rice into her bowl
Stir in {@carrot:toddler} and top with {@pomegranate:toddler}, lightly crushed

method.title: Temper and finish
items: Heat {@oil} in a small pan; add {@cumin} and {@mustard}
When they splutter, add {@red-chili}, {@chana}, {@urad} and {@cashews}; fry until the dal turns golden
When the curry leaves turn crisp, add {@hing} and turn off the stove — if using bottle gourd instead of cucumber, stir it into the hot tempering now
Pour the tempering over the curd rice and mix
Garnish with {@pomegranate:garnish}; serve with pickle, podi or papad

method.label: Tip
method.text: The carrot in the original veggie mix now goes in her bowl only; adults get cucumber (or bottle gourd). Curd rice firms up as it sits — loosen with a splash of milk or more curd before serving, and refrigerate leftovers up to a day.
